top_signals.title: Renewables Stocks Soar as Democrats Sweep U.S. Congress
top_signals.summary: Renewable energy stocks rallied in Asia and Europe on Wednesday as Tuesday’s mid-term elections in the United States resulted in a sweeping victory for the Democrats, who took control of both the House and Senate. The “blue wave” of the elections turned into a “blue trade” in equity markets, where renewable energy stocks soared at opening in many Asian and European markets.
